title: "Computing access"
---

To access RStudio at the College of Idaho, go to the [CofI Posit Workbench]({{< var rstudio_url >}}) website and sign in using your CofI email and password.

::: callout-note
The Workbench servers are being updated this semester, so this address may change. Check back here or watch for an announcement if the link stops working.
:::
